summary: A significant organized retail theft took place at Bay Area Electronics, a store on Lakeshore Avenue in Oakland, on April 18, 2024. The operation involved two individuals working in tandem: one created a distraction while the other accessed locked merchandise using a magnetic security key that may have been obtained during an earlier visit. The stolen goods — five high-end smartphones including iPhones and Samsung Galaxy devices — totaled just under $6,200 in value. The suspects fled via the store's rear exit in a silver SUV. Store management links this to an earlier theft with matching tactics and has involved the organized retail crime task force.
